newsitem.title: FRANCE: Parliament adopts frontal crash tests report.
newsitem.headline: Parliament adopts frontal crash tests report.

text.p: The European Parliament adopted on Thursday its report on the European Commission proposal to tighten up test procedures for frontal impact vehicle crashes.

Euro-MPs' vote, to complete their second reading under the co-decision procedure, was based on amended Commission proposal COM(94)520 for a Council Decision on motor vehicles' frontal impact resistance.
British Socialist Alan Donnelly, the parliament's rapporteur, put forward a series of detailed technical amendments for vehicle test procedures as they concerned test dummies' ankles.
In his explanatory statement, Donnelly noted the Commission's apparent support for his amendments, which are based on the latest work of the European Experimental Vehicles Committee.
